community_list_entries.name: Assembling Insights for Agentic Machine Learning Engineering Systems

phase1_classification.kind_reason: Introduces MLE-InsightBench: 160 Kaggle competitions with a leakage-controlled source/target split. It measures how insights from related tasks (domain, competition and improvement insights, injected as skills or a playbook) change agent performance on held-out targets. The paper motivates this with

phase1_verified_types.procedural_workflow: §3 (held-out split): "an agentic MLE system facing a new task can draw on prior experience, but not on experience derived from the new task itself"; insights injected "as on-demand skills" (Abstract).
